About Akansh Dhull & His Preparation Journey

Akansh Dhull, who was born in Rohtak, Haryana, finished his education at St. Kabir Public School and Bhavan Vidyalaya in Chandigarh. He pursued B.Com (Honours) from Shri Ram College of Commerce, University of Delhi. His father Krishan Dhull serves in public life while his mother works in education.

He started his UPSC preparation in 2021 and he focused on studying NCERTs and standard textbooks and current events. His first attempt at the UPSC CSE 2023 exam resulted in an AIR 342 score which provided him with important testing experience. His second attempt at the 2024 examination resulted in an improvement to AIR 295 after he enhanced his answer writing skills and study methods. He achieved exceptional success in his 4th attempt because he learned from previous attempts and developed a new strategy through mock practice and better integration of current affairs with static subjects which helped him secure AIR 3 in UPSC CSE 2025.
